recommended_path: Spolek (association) for simplicity and zero court fees; nadace (foundation) if an endowment-based structure is required
entity_types: Spolek (association — 3+ founders, common interest; registered in the spolkový rejstřík)
Nadace (foundation — dataset label 'OUK'; 1 founder, endowment min. 100,000 CZK, notarial deed, Commercial Register)
z.ú. (zájmové sdružení / interest association — lighter, not a full legal entity)

requirements.founders: Spolek: 3+ founders with a common interest (Civil Code Act 89/2012 Sb., § 226 et seq.); Czech citizenship not required. Nadace: 1 founder (zřizovatel), minimum endowment 100,000 CZK
requirements.local_presence: Spolek: place of business in Czechia (seats/branches); nadace: registered office (sídlo) in Czechia
requirements.documents: Spolek: application to the spolkový rejstřík (statute + founders + registered office). Nadace: notarial deed of foundation (listina notářského zápisu) + Commercial Register application

forms: Spolek: application form for the spolkový rejstřík (paper or e-filing; the registry court is the Městský soud v Praze / regional courts)
Nadace: notarial deed + Commercial Register application (Obchodní rejstřík)
No official free online form portal; paper submission at the registry court is the norm for spolek

fees.item: Spolek registration in the spolkový rejstřík
fees.source: amended § 11 Act 549/1991 Sb. (fee schedule; association-register entries exempt), full tariff at https://www.zakonyprolidi.cz/cs/1991-549; https://poradna.crdm.cz (free spolkový rejstřík entries)
fees.note: Supersedes the v2 note 'spolek court fee is 1,000 CZK (not free)'. The 1,000 CZK figure in epravo.cz articles predates the exemption and must not be cited for current registrations.

fees.item: Spolek notary (optional, e.g. for power of attorney / notarized application)
fees.source: market rate (Czech notary tariff for a simple notarized signature / application)
fees.note: Not legally required for a basic paper filing

fees.source: inferred from the general fee schedule: Act 549/1991 Sb. tariff (https://www.zakonyprolidi.cz/cs/1991-549, https://msp.gov.cz/documents/33609/1046892/Příloha+-+SAZEBNÍK+POPLATKŮ.pdf, https://www.businessinfo.cz/navody/zapis-do-obchodniho-rejstriku-ppbi/5)
fees.note: Tier = first entry of a legal person excluding a.s. (8,000/12,000 CZK) and spolek (0 CZK). Not pinned to a nadace-explicit source — labeled as inferred from the general tariff, not a primary nadace fee.

fees.source: Civil Code Act 89/2012 Sb. (nadace, minimum endowment)
fees.note: This is the founding capital, separate from court fees

timelines.spolek: 4-8 weeks (statutory 2-month decision period; legal existence arises on entry into the spolkový rejstřík, Civil Code § 226)

supersedes: Prior v2 'Spolek court fee is 1,000 CZK (not free); total ~2,000-3,500 CZK' corrected: spolek entry is fee-free under amended § 11 Act 549/1991 Sb.
Prior v2 'Spolek needs 5+ members' corrected: law requires 3+ founders.
